resources.string: Add two or more PDF files. They are joined in the order shown here.
Add at least two files to merge.
Fix or remove the files marked with a problem first.
Pages to use (all if empty), e.g. 1-3, 6
Protected. Enter its password to use it.
This is not a PDF file. Remove it.
This file is over 128 MB. Remove it.
This file could not be read. Remove it.
This file is damaged. Remove it.
Some files were left out: the list is limited to 50 files and 256 MB together.
Large files can take a while. You can cancel.
Cancelled. Nothing was written. Stopping restarts the PDF engine, which is normal: nothing was lost and your list is unchanged.
The merged file is ready. Choose where to save it. Your original files are not changed.
The merged file could not be written there. Choose another place, or try again.
Saved. Your original files are unchanged.
That is too large for the PDF engine. Try fewer or smaller files or pages. Nothing was written.
The protection of a file does not allow pages to be copied out of it. Nothing was written.
This took too long and was stopped. Nothing was written. Try fewer files or pages.
The PDF engine stopped unexpectedly. Nothing was written and your work is unchanged. Try again.
A file is damaged or is not a valid PDF. Nothing was written.
That did not work. Nothing was written.
Type the pages to use, for example 1-3, 6.
Use page numbers and ranges separated by commas, for example 1-3, 6.
A range must go upwards, like 3-5, not 5-3.
That page does not exist. This document has %1$d pages.
A page is listed more than once. Each page can appear only once.
Enter a number of 1 or more.
Enter a number smaller than the %1$d pages of this document.
Page 1 always starts the first part. Start from page 2.
That would make more than 1000 files. Choose a larger number.
New part starts at pages, e.g. 4, 9
The pages are copied into a new file. This document is not changed.
Each part is saved as part-01.pdf, part-02.pdf and so on, in a folder you choose.
Page 1 starts the first part. Each page you list starts a new one.
%1$d files will be made, from %2$s to %3$s
Cancelled. Nothing was written. Stopping restarts the PDF engine, which is normal: nothing was lost and your document is unchanged.
The new file is ready. Choose where to save it.
%1$d files are ready. Choose a folder to save them in.
The file could not be written there. Choose another place, or try again.
Saved %1$d files. This document is unchanged.
Saved %1$d of %2$d files. Writing stopped at part %3$d. Check that the folder has room and can be written to, then try again.
